intended_object: This is an auxiliary covering object used to build the cylinder pre-1-hypercover `cylinder f g`, which gives a homotopy between two morphisms `f g : E ⟶ F` of pre-1-hypercovers. Its docstring calls it "(Implementation)".
explanation: The docstring says outright that this is an implementation detail: it is the covering object at index `(i, k)` of the construction `cylinder f g`. The object is the pullback of the map `E.X i ⟶ F.X (f.s₀ i) ×_S F.X (g.s₀ i)`, induced by `f.h₀ i` and `g.h₀ i`, along `F.toPullback k : F.Y k ⟶ F.X _ ×_S F.X _`. It has no standalone meaning in the literature, apart from its role as a component of the cylinder construction. It is a technical device, so it is not a mathematical object to compare against a textbook definition.
